_comment: Hand-verified Nexon name -> item ID pins. Used when a rate-table name has no exact dataset match (Classic-exclusive or renamed retail item). NEVER guess: verify sub/cash/art in game or maplestory.io first. Applied by pnpm catalog with top priority.
